scripts.dev: npm run build && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local --config worker/wrangler.local.toml && wrangler dev --config worker/wrangler.local.toml
scripts.db:migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local --config worker/wrangler.local.toml
scripts.db:migrate:remote: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --config worker/wrangler.toml
scripts.deploy: npm run build && wrangler deploy --config worker/wrangler.toml
